점심.e: Same word as Chinese 'dim sum' — originally a light snack, now lunch. Just learn it whole.

휴지.x: There's no toilet paper in the bathroom.

운전하다.x: My father drives to work every day.
운전하다.t: Drive a car: 차를 운전하다. Common goodbye: 운전 조심하세요 'Drive safely.'

길다.x: My younger sibling has long hair.
길다.e: 길이 = length. 길 (road) is a separate word.

후배.x: I gave my old books to a junior student.
후배.e: Literally 'later generation' — someone who started after you.

출근하다.m: to go to work, to report for work
출근하다.ex: 저는 보통 아침 여덟 시에 회사에 출근해요.
출근하다.x: I usually get to the office at eight in the morning.
출근하다.t: Use 회사에 출근하다 for the place; 회사로 출근하다 also works to show direction.

거절하다.m: to refuse, to decline, to turn down
거절하다.ex: 너무 바빠서 친구의 부탁을 미안하지만 거절했어요.
거절하다.x: I was too busy, so I turned down my friend's request, though I felt sorry.

세다.x: The child counted from one to ten on his fingers.
세다.e: Homonym warning: the adjective 세다 means 'strong'; 셈 'counting' comes from this verb.
세다.t: The polite form 세요 looks like the honorific ending -세요; context tells you which it is.

참다.m: to put up with, to endure, to hold back
참다.ex: 너무 웃겨서 웃음을 참을 수 없었어요.
참다.x: It was so funny that I couldn't hold back my laughter.

반대하다.m: to oppose, to be against, to object
반대하다.x: At first, my parents were against my marriage.
반대하다.t: The noun 반대 also means 'opposite': 반대 방향 = the opposite direction.

진찰.x: I was examined by the doctor.
진찰.t: The doctor 진찰하다; the patient 진찰을 받다.

부작용.ex: 이 약은 부작용이 거의 없어서 안전해요.
부작용.x: This medicine is safe because it has almost no side effects.
부작용.t: It's also used figuratively for any unwanted result of a policy or plan.

계기.m: opportunity, turning point, trigger (for a change)
계기.ex: 이 여행을 계기로 한국어 공부를 시작했어요.
계기.x: This trip was what got me started studying Korean.
계기.e: The moment that sets something in motion.
계기.t: N을 계기로 'with N as the turning point' is the key pattern.

조절하다.m: to adjust, to control, to regulate (amount or level)
조절하다.x: Please adjust the air conditioner temperature.
조절하다.t: 조절 is for amounts or levels like temperature or volume; 조정 is for plans, schedules or positions.

인공 지능.ex: 요즘 인공 지능 기술이 빠르게 발전하고 있어요.
인공 지능.x: AI technology is developing rapidly these days.
인공 지능.t: In everyday speech, people often just say AI, pronounced 에이아이.

파마.x: I wanted a change of mood, so I got a perm.
파마.e: From English 'permanent (wave)', shortened; Koreans say 파마하다, 'to get a perm'.

이용객.x: The number of airport users rises sharply on weekends.
이용객.t: 이용객 is for people visiting places like stations or parks; for websites or services, use 이용자.

보도하다.ex: 방송사들이 그 사고를 하루 종일 보도했습니다.
보도하다.x: The broadcasters covered the accident all day long.
보도하다.t: Used for news coverage only; for reporting to a boss, use 보고하다.

의지하다.m: to depend on, rely on, lean on
의지하다.x: I relied on my family a lot when things were hard.
의지하다.t: Homonym warning: the noun 의지 also means 'willpower', a different word.

후기.m: review (written by a customer or attendee)
후기.x: The reviews were good, so I bought this bag.
후기.t: Very common online: 구매 후기 'purchase review', 여행 후기 'travel write-up'. 리뷰 is used the same way.

점포.ex: 이 거리에는 문을 닫은 점포가 많아졌어요.
점포.x: There are more closed stores on this street now.

항생제.ex: 의사 선생님이 항생제를 사흘 동안 먹으라고 하셨어요.
항생제.x: The doctor told me to take antibiotics for three days.
항생제.e: Literally 'anti-life drug' — a direct translation of 'antibiotic' (fights living germs).

수필.ex: 그 작가는 여행에 대한 수필을 자주 써요.
수필.x: That writer often writes essays about travel.
수필.e: Literally 'following the brush' — writing freely as thoughts come.
수필.t: 수필 is a personal, literary essay; a school paper is usually called 보고서 or 리포트.

원리.ex: 이 기계가 움직이는 원리를 설명해 주세요.
원리.x: Please explain the principle behind how this machine works.
원리.t: 원리 is how something works; 원칙 is a rule or principle you follow.

산소.x: Plants take in sunlight and make oxygen.
산소.e: Literally 'acid element' — oxygen was once thought to be in all acids.
산소.t: Homonym: another 산소 means 'grave' (polite), as in 산소에 가다 'to visit a grave'.

탐사.ex: 과학자들이 화성 탐사를 위해 로봇을 보냈어요.
탐사.x: Scientists sent a robot to explore Mars.

믿음직하다.ex: 우리 형은 어려울 때 언제나 믿음직한 사람이에요.
믿음직하다.x: My older brother is always someone I can count on in hard times.
믿음직하다.e: 믿음 'trust' (from 믿다) + -직하다 'rather, fairly' — worthy of trust.

눈치를 보다.forms: 눈치를 봐요 · 눈치를 봤어요 · 눈치 보지 마세요
눈치를 보다.m: to watch someone's mood, to walk on eggshells, to worry about others' reactions
눈치를 보다.ex: 신입 사원이라서 아직 상사 눈치를 많이 봐요.
눈치를 보다.x: I'm a new employee, so I still worry a lot about my boss's reactions.
눈치를 보다.t: 눈치 보지 마세요 is a kind way to say 'Don't worry about what others think.'

가급적.m: as much as possible, if at all possible
가급적.x: Please come to the meeting as early as possible.
가급적.e: Literally 'as far as one can reach.'

날로.forms: 날로 + change verb (날로 심해지다); 날로 먹다 = eat raw / get for free
날로.ex: 도시의 교통 문제가 날로 심각해지고 있습니다.
날로.x: The city's traffic problems are growing more serious by the day.
날로.e: 날 'day' + -로. Homonym warning: 날 also means 'raw', so 날로 먹다 = eat raw.
날로.t: Slang 날로 먹다 means 'to get something without any effort'.

낱낱이.m: one by one, in every detail, thoroughly
낱낱이.x: The police revealed every detail of the truth behind the case.
낱낱이.e: 낱 'a single piece' doubled + -이: 'piece by piece'.

주최하다.e: Literally 'mainly hold' — the organizer of an event.

털다.forms: 털어요 · 털었어요 · 털 거예요 · 터세요 (ㄹ drops)
털다.m: to shake off, dust off; to rob (slang)
털다.ex: 집에 들어가기 전에 신발의 눈을 털었어요.
털다.x: I shook the snow off my shoes before going inside.
털다.t: Slang: 가게를 털다 means to rob a store.

만만하다.m: easy, easy to handle; a pushover
만만하다.x: This exam isn't as easy as I thought.
만만하다.e: Homonym warning: 자신감이 만만하다 'full of confidence' is a different word.
만만하다.t: Very common in the negative: 만만치 않다 / 만만하지 않다 means 'tough, not to be taken lightly'.

아담하다.x: Our house is small, but it's cozy and pretty.
아담하다.e: Literally 'elegant and plain' — small in a charming way.

비결.x: What's your grandma's secret to staying healthy?
비결.t: 비결 is a positive 'secret to success'; a hidden fact you keep is 비밀.

완결.x: The webtoon I was reading has finally ended.
완결.t: 완결되다 or 완결이 나다 = (a series) ends; 완결작 = a finished series, perfect for reading in one go.

위조.ex: 그들은 여권을 위조한 혐의로 조사를 받았습니다.
위조.x: They were investigated on suspicion of forging passports.

신빙성.ex: 그 기사는 출처가 불분명해서 신빙성이 떨어져요.
신빙성.x: That article's source is unclear, so it lacks credibility.
신빙성.e: Literally 'the quality of being trustworthy and reliable'.
신빙성.t: Common pattern: 신빙성이 있다 / 없다 / 떨어지다.

물의.ex: 그 배우는 음주 운전으로 물의를 일으켰어요.
물의.x: That actor caused a scandal by driving drunk.
물의.e: Literally 'public discussion' — gossip and criticism from the crowd.
물의.t: Almost always used as 물의를 일으키다 / 빚다 (to cause a public scandal).

깨우치다.m: to enlighten, to make (someone) realize; to come to realize
깨우치다.ex: 선생님은 학생들에게 배움의 기쁨을 깨우쳐 주셨어요.
깨우치다.x: The teacher helped the students discover the joy of learning.
깨우치다.e: Related to 깨다 'to wake up' and 깨닫다 'to realize' — waking up the mind.
깨우치다.t: Often used with 주다 to mean opening someone else's eyes: 깨우쳐 주다.

방법론.ex: 이 논문은 연구 방법론에 문제가 있다는 지적을 받았습니다.
방법론.x: This paper was criticized for problems in its research methodology.
방법론.t: Pronounced [방범논]: ㅂ + ㄹ shifts to ㅁ + ㄴ.

부피.ex: 이 상자는 가볍지만 부피가 커서 옮기기 힘들어요.
부피.x: This box is light, but it's bulky, so it's hard to move.
부피.e: Native word; think how much space something takes up, not how heavy it is.
부피.t: Say 부피가 크다/작다 for 'bulky/compact'; the science term is also 부피, while 볼륨 means sound volume.

물류.ex: 온라인 쇼핑이 늘면서 물류 센터도 많아졌어요.
물류.x: As online shopping grew, logistics centers increased too.

유래하다.x: This word originally comes from French.

부인하다.e: Literally 'not acknowledge'; the opposite of 시인하다.
부인하다.t: Homonym warning: the noun 부인 also means 'wife' (夫人).

묶이다.m: to be tied (up), to be bound; to be stuck, to be held up
묶이다.ex: 폭설로 많은 사람들이 공항에 발이 묶였어요.
묶이다.x: Because of heavy snow, many people were stranded at the airport.
묶이다.e: Passive of 묶다 'to tie, to bundle'.
묶이다.t: 발이 묶이다, literally 'one's feet are tied', means 'to be stranded'.

이열치열.m: fighting heat with heat; fighting fire with fire
이열치열.ex: 더운 여름에 이열치열로 뜨거운 삼계탕을 먹어요.
이열치열.x: In the hot summer, we eat hot ginseng chicken soup to fight heat with heat.
이열치열.t: Koreans cite it when eating hot soups like 삼계탕 on 복날, the hottest summer days.

단면.m: cross section; one side, a glimpse (of something)
단면.ex: 이 사건은 우리 사회의 한 단면을 보여 줍니다.
단면.x: This incident shows one side of our society.
단면.e: Literally 'cut surface' — a slice that shows what's inside.

전조.ex: 갑작스러운 두통은 큰 병의 전조일 수도 있어요.
전조.x: A sudden headache could be a warning sign of a serious illness.

칠순.ex: 다음 달에 아버지의 칠순 잔치를 열 거예요.
칠순.x: Next month we're going to throw a party for my father's 70th birthday.

수완.m: skill, knack, savvy (in dealing with business or people)
수완.ex: 그는 사업 수완이 뛰어나서 회사를 크게 키웠어요.
수완.x: He has great business savvy and grew the company big.
수완.t: Mostly with business and negotiation: 사업 수완, 수완이 좋다 (be savvy).

내정불간섭.ex: 두 나라는 내정불간섭 원칙을 지키기로 합의했습니다.
내정불간섭.x: The two countries agreed to uphold the principle of non-interference in internal affairs.

측정치.ex: 세 번 측정한 측정치의 평균을 계산했어요.
측정치.x: We calculated the average of three measured values.
측정치.t: -치 = value: 측정치, 평균치 (average value), 최고치 (peak value).

아이러니.ex: 도둑이 도둑을 맞다니 정말 아이러니한 일이에요.
아이러니.x: A thief getting robbed — how ironic is that?
아이러니.t: In literature classes the Sino-Korean term 반어 is used; in daily talk people say 아이러니하다.

심기일전.m: a fresh start, turning over a new leaf
심기일전.x: Let's put the failure behind us and start again with a fresh mind.
심기일전.e: Literally 'the workings of the heart turn completely around'.
심기일전.t: Common as 심기일전하다, often at New Year or after a setback.

보도자료.ex: 회사는 신제품 출시에 맞춰 보도자료를 배포했습니다.
보도자료.x: The company distributed a press release timed to the new product launch.
보도자료.e: Literally 'reporting materials' handed out to journalists.
보도자료.t: Usual verbs: 보도자료를 내다 or 배포하다 'to issue a press release'.

가미하다.m: to add, to season with; to incorporate (an element)
가미하다.ex: 이 영화는 역사적 사실에 상상력을 가미했습니다.
가미하다.x: This film added imagination to historical facts.
가미하다.e: Literally 'add flavor': first to food, then to ideas or styles.
가미하다.t: Used figuratively in writing: A에 B를 가미하다 means 'to add a touch of B to A.'

외려.ex: 친구를 도와주려다가 외려 일을 더 망쳤어요.
외려.x: I tried to help my friend but made things even worse instead.
